answer.evidence: Rows 1-4 form a uniform light-grey top band. Row 5 is a lighter front-edge line (L=189), followed by darker eave shadow in rows 6-7 and the dark shelf opening in rows 8-9. This matches the green cabinet reference (top band, edge line, eave). Below it is a front face about 25 rows tall: open shelf bays with light shelf-edge lines at rows 18 and 28, and a base. The bottles are goods on the shelves and count as decor.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a glass-fronted shelf with small bottles. The tile facts are good: 26 visible tones per tile against 17-20 for the stall and well, and 0% near-flat coverage. The structure is shallower than the references. The frame and cabinet body show only about 3-4 lightness steps, where the cheese stall and roofed well carry 5-6 on each material. The glass interior is a pale, mostly uniform field, and the bottles are tiny clusters. 100% of the dark edge pixels are near-neutral, so the cabinet is wrapped in a uniform neutral dark line. That is the sticker look. The tinted references (hedge 0%, stall 1%, well 33%) use outlines in the dark tone of the adjacent material instead. Only the lamp reference is fully neutral, and it is a thin iron post, so it is not a fair comparison for a furniture piece. Overall the piece is cleanly drawn but flatter and more outlined than the Beodeul standard.

styleAnswer.evidence: Density and texture are fine. The candidate has 26 visible tones per tile, against 17-20 for the stall and well references. Near-flat coverage is 0%, and the bottles and shelves carry small varied details. The weak point is the outline. 100% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral, so the dark line around the cabinet carries no material tint. The tinted references (hedge 0%, stall 1%) separate forms by dark material tone, whereas this reads as a uniform dark grey sticker outline. The grey cabinet frame also has only about 4 lightness steps, short of the 5-6 Beodeul uses per material. Because the outline is neutral and the frame ramp is shallower than the references, a careful artist would not accept it next to them. When in doubt, fail.
